DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for cleaning products?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つを混ぜると、汚れがよく落ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗剤混合の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Will mixing these two remove dirt better?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the cleaning products may be mixed.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 混ぜず、表示された用途と注意を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't mix them. Check the stated uses and precautions.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 混ぜる予定をやめます。浴室の床に使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 混合をやめ用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll abandon the mixing plan. I want to use a product on the bathroom floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not mix them and explain the intended use.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 素材の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have information about the material?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 床材の説明書が家にあります。今は種類が不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 床材情報が未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The floor-material instructions are at home. I don't know the type now.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the flooring material information is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 素材に合うか不明なまま選ばない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's better not to choose without knowing whether it suits the material.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真だけで決めず、説明書と商品の表示を比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明書と表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't decide from a photo alone; I'll compare the instructions and product labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the instructions and labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの商品は今日は購入されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you purchase both products today?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いえ、表示を控えて帰ります。用途に合う一つを後で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入を保留し用途に合う一品を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, I'll note the labels and go home. I'll choose one suitable product later.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Defer purchase and consider one suitable product in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品はこちらで棚へ戻します。混合ではなく、それぞれの表示に従ってご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll return the products to the shelf. Consider each according to its own label rather than mixing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me the product's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋の継ぎ目が開いています。テープで戻す前に相談しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋の継ぎ目開きと未補修を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bag's seam is open. I came to ask before taping it back together.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the open bag seam and that you have not repaired it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家で出した時です。店で開いていたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見時点と発生時点不明を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I took it out at home. I don't know whether it was open at the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish discovery time from the unknown time it happened in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身は使われましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使っていません。開いた所と袋全体の写真があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用と写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I have photographs of the open part and the whole bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is unused and show the photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入記録も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can we check the purchase record too?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートがあります。テープで状態を隠さず、そのまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 補修で状態を隠さず購入記録を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the receipt. I'll show it as it is without covering the condition with tape.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the purchase record in Japanese without concealing the condition through repair.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現物の扱いを担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain how to handle the actual item.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。交換済みとは考えず、袋の不具合として確認を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換確定でなく状態確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll request a check of the bag defect without assuming an exchange has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a condition check in Japanese rather than treat exchange as confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未使用品の袋の状態と購入記録を確認する相談として承りました。担当が対応を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've accepted an inquiry to check an unused product's bag condition and purchase record. Staff will explain the response.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about registering a move-in, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物は来週届きますが、私はもう住んでいます。日付を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 居住開始と荷物到着の別日を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: My belongings arrive next week, but I'm already living there. I'd like advice about the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about different dates for beginning residence and luggage arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に住み始めた日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you actually start living there?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今月三日です。荷物の到着を転居日とは書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の居住開始日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: The third of this month. I haven't written the belongings' arrival as my moving date.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the actual start-of-residence date in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前の住居の利用状況も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us how the previous home is being used too.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 退去しています。今は新住所で寝泊まりしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住居退去と現在の寝泊まりを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've moved out. I now sleep and stay at the new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you vacated the old home and now stay at the new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 契約や住み始めた経過を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell staff about the contract and how you began living there.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約開始は一日です。三つの日を混ぜず説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約日も別に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contract began on the first. I'll explain without mixing the three dates.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the contract date separately in Japanese too.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同時に移る家族はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is any family moving at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私だけです。まだ前の家に住む家族まで含めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動対象は本人のみと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only me. I won't include family still living at the previous home.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that only you are moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一日契約、三日居住開始、来週荷物到着として担当へ引き継ぎます。用紙の日付は案内後に記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on contract from the first, residence from the third and belongings next week. Fill in the form's date after guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙と電子版が届きました。二回払う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙と電子通知の二重払いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received paper and electronic versions. Do I need to pay twice?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about possible double payment for paper and electronic notices.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号、税目、期間を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the numbers, tax category and period.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 件名は同じですが、番号をまだ比べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 件名だけで同一と決めず番号比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: The subject is the same, but I haven't compared the numbers yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a number comparison in Japanese without assuming the same subject means the same notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙と画面を並べて見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show the paper and screen side by side, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。電子版を消して一件にした扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両資料を消さず提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I won't delete the electronic one and treat that as making them a single item.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present both documents without deleting either in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 支払いの記録もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a payment record too?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ払っていません。重複か確認してから進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未払いと照合後の支払い希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't paid yet. I'd like to proceed after checking whether they're duplicates.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not paid and want to pay after comparison.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限も両方確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今月末です。問い合わせ中だから期限が消えるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限を保持して相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: The end of this month. I won't assume making an inquiry removes the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the deadline in mind while consulting.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの通知と未払いの状態を担当へ引き継ぎます。対象を照合して支払い方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass both notices and the unpaid status to staff. We'll compare the items and explain how to pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文前の確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything to check before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵を避けています。麺を替えられると言われましたが、スープも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 麺変更案内とスープ確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm avoiding egg. I was told the noodles could be changed, but I'd like the soup checked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the noodle-change guidance and checking the soup.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更可能という案内だけでは、全体の対応を保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: An indication that a change is possible alone cannot guarantee the whole dish meets your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。麺だけの返事だったので、料理全体を担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更返答の範囲を料理全体へ広げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. That answer was only about noodles, so please tell the person responsible about the entire dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Expand the scope of the change inquiry to the whole dish in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加の料理もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like any additional dishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 餃子も考えていましたが、まだ通さず同じ条件で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加餃子も保留して条件確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was considering dumplings too, but don't place that order yet; please check them under the same conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put extra dumplings on hold and request a conditions check in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 材料と調理条件を担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will explain the ingredients and preparation conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明後に選びます。友人の卵入り料理とは分けて食べる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と料理を分ける予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll choose after the explanation. I plan to eat separately from my friend's dish containing egg.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to keep your food separate from your companion's.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分けて食べる予定も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on that plan too.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 対応が確認できなければ、両方とも注文をやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対応未確認なら注文を取りやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the arrangements cannot be confirmed, I'll cancel the idea of ordering both dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will abandon the orders if the arrangements are unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 麺、スープ、餃子と食べ方を担当へ確認します。今はどの注文も確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check noodles, soup, dumplings and how you will eat with staff. No orders are finalized now.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人だけ帰ります。残る人の追加注文と分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先に帰る人と追加注文の分離を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only one of us is leaving. Can that be separated from additional orders by those staying?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about separating the departing person from additional orders.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここまでの注文は一緒の伝票です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: The orders up to now are on a shared bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今までの料理も食べたので、飲み物だけ払うとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既注文料理の負担も認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: I ate the food already ordered too, so I won't say I'll pay only for my drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your share of already ordered dishes in Japanese too.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お仲間と負担を決めていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you agree on the shares with your group?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談します。まだ誰の分も払っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仲間間の負担未決定と未払いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll discuss it. None of us has paid yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the group's shares are undecided and no payment has been made.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店側で分けられる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check what payment separation the restaurant can handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に友人へ現金を渡す方法も考えます。店への精算とは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私的金銭授受と店精算を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also consider giving cash to my friend first. That's separate from settling with the restaurant.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish a private money transfer from restaurant settlement in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追加の注文はまだ通さずお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll wait without placing the extra order yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全員で決めました。今までの伝票をまとめて払い、その後は残る二人で頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員合意で現在伝票をまとめて払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Everyone has agreed. We'll settle the current bill together; after that, the two staying will order.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that everyone agreed to pay the current bill together.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の伝票を会計し、その後の二人分は新しい注文として受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll settle the current bill and take the remaining two people's later order as a new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: セットのご注文ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。飲み物だけ食後に持ってきてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: セット飲料の食後提供を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Could only the drink be brought after the meal?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request the set drink after the meal in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: セットの飲み物を食後ということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean the drink included in the set after your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。別の飲み物を追加する希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提供時期変更で追加注文ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I'm not requesting another additional drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that this is a timing change, not an extra order.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先に注文の内訳を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: First I'll check the order breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 料理一つとセットの紅茶一杯です。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料理と飲料の数量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: One dish and one tea included in the set.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm food and drink quantities in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食後のお届けが可能か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether delivery after the meal is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無理なら料理と一緒で構いません。二杯は要りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更不可時の代案と追加不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: If not, together with the food is fine. I don't need two cups.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give an alternative if the change is unavailable and say no extra drink is needed in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では食後にお届けできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this scenario, we can bring it after the meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。食べ終わったら声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食後の声掛けに応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll call you when I've finished eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree in Japanese to notify staff after the meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 料理一つ、セットの紅茶一杯を食後としてお受けします。追加注文はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take one dish and one set tea served after the meal. There is no additional order.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出口についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傘を入口に置きました。この出口から戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘を残した入口への戻り道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my umbrella at the entrance. Can I get back there from this exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the way back to the entrance where you left your umbrella.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの傘置場か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which umbrella storage place?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 正面の棚です。黒い傘で、持ち手に私の札があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傘置場と私物の目印を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: The shelf at the front. A black umbrella with my tag on the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the umbrella location and your identifying mark in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の通路で正面へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can return to the front by the outer passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 参拝の列を逆に歩かず、その通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列を逆行せず外通路を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use that passage rather than walk backwards through the worship queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the outer passage rather than go against the queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 御朱印の受付にも寄られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you stop at the goshuin reception too?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ、今日は傘を取って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 御朱印に寄らず帰る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, today I'll take my umbrella and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave without stopping for a seal.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ色の傘もあるので目印を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are umbrellas of the same color too, so check your identifying mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札を見て自分の物だけ取ります。不明なら受付へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目印で自分の傘を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look at the tag and take only mine. If unsure, I'll ask reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match your own umbrella using its mark in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では外側の通路から正面の傘置場へどうぞ。受付の列に並び直す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take the outer passage to the front umbrella storage. You don't need to queue again at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に、待機場所へイヤホンを落としました。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車前の落下物を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before that, I dropped an earbud in the waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a dropped item before boarding in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。自分で入らず、係員に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 境界内へ入らず係員確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I won't go in myself; I'd like staff to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for staff to check without entering the boundary yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 安全な位置でお待ちください。特徴は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait in a safe position. What does it look like?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い片耳用です。今も見えますが手を伸ばしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物の特徴と無接触を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: One white earbud. I can still see it, but won't reach for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the item's features and say in Japanese that you will not touch it.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗車の順番をどうするか担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will explain how to handle your boarding turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 回収のために急いで乗るつもりはありません。後の便でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回収を急がず乗車延期に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't intend to hurry aboard to retrieve it. A later departure is fine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree in Japanese to postpone boarding rather than rush retrieval.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お連れの方は乗車されますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人とも待ちます。友人にも先に進まないよう伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者も待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll both wait. I've told my friend not to proceed ahead too.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your companion will wait too.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二人の乗車を保留して担当へ報告しました。その位置から離れず案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've put both people's boarding on hold and reported to staff. Stay in that position and wait for guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写生した場所へ画板を置いてきました。戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 置き忘れた道具への戻り道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my drawing board where I was sketching. I'd like to go back.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the way back to your forgotten equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所の目印は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember a landmark for the place?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の手前の木陰です。画板の写真はあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写生場所の目印と写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the shade of the tree before the pond. I have a photograph of the drawing board.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the sketching-place landmark and show the photograph in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行できる経路を確認します。同行者はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check a route you can use. Are you with anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口で待っています。勝手に別出口へ帰らないよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者に待機連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: They're waiting at the entrance. I'll contact them so they don't head home through another exit on their own.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your companion to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この道で木陰へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: This path takes you back to the shade.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。立入禁止の近道は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 許可された道で戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I won't use a shortcut marked no entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return by the permitted route.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻るときも入口側へ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you head toward the entrance when coming back too?

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。画板がなければ、特徴を受付へ届けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未発見時は受付へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If the board isn't there, I'll report its features to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult reception if it is not found.

DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この道で木陰を確認し、同じ通路で入口へお戻りください。見つからなければ受付で相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-014-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the tree shade using this route, then return to the entrance along the same passage. If you don't find it, you can ask reception.
